ex.en: Hackers are adept at getting around computer security measures.
ex.zh: 駭客很擅長繞過電腦的安全措施。

ex.en: Hackers find new ways of infiltrating private or public networks.
ex.zh: 駭客不斷找到入侵私人或公共網路的新方法。

ex.en: Many people cannot understand the way hackers behave.
ex.zh: 很多人無法理解駭客的行為。

hacker.en: a person who uses computers to get into other people's systems without permission

ex.en: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.
ex.zh: 從硬體轉向軟體的轉變是逐步發生的。

ex.en: We need to upgrade our computer hardware.
ex.zh: 我們需要升級電腦硬體。

hardware.en: the machines and physical parts of a computer

ex.en: I bought some nails at the hardware store.
ex.zh: 我在五金行買了一些釘子。

ex.en: The hardware store sells paint and tools.
ex.zh: 五金行有賣油漆和工具。

hardware.en: tools and metal objects used in the home and garden

ex.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.
ex.zh: 吸菸有害健康。

ex.en: Some medicines can be harmful to the body.
ex.zh: 有些藥物可能對身體有害。

ex.en: This medicine doesn't have any harmful side effects.
ex.zh: 這種藥沒有有害的副作用。

harmful.en: causing damage or making someone sick

ex.en: That's very handy.
ex.zh: 這很方便。

ex.en: This app is really handy for booking taxis.
ex.zh: 這個 App 叫計程車很方便。

ex.en: It really comes in handy.
ex.zh: 這真的很能派上用場。

ex.en: A flashlight will come in handy if the power goes out.
ex.zh: 停電時手電筒就能派上用場。

handy.en: to be useful in a certain situation

handy.zh: 就在手邊的、隨手可得的

ex.en: I'll keep this information handy for future reference.
ex.zh: 我會把這份資料放在手邊，方便日後參考。

ex.en: Keep your passport handy at the airport.
ex.zh: 在機場時把護照放在隨手拿得到的地方。

handy.en: close by and easy to reach

ex.en: She is handy with a needle.
ex.zh: 她很會做針線活。

ex.en: Tom is handy with tools.
ex.zh: 湯姆很會用工具。

handy.en: good at using something with your hands

ex.en: Hazardous materials must be stored safely.
ex.zh: 危險物品必須安全存放。

ex.en: Smoking is hazardous to your health.
ex.zh: 吸菸有害健康。

ex.en: Driving in this fog is hazardous.
ex.zh: 在這種濃霧中開車很危險。

hazardous.en: dangerous, especially to health or safety

ex.en: He is a habitual smoker.
ex.zh: 他是個老菸槍。

ex.en: She ordered her habitual cup of black coffee.
ex.zh: 她照例點了一杯黑咖啡。

habitual.en: done often or regularly as a habit

ex.en: The hallway needs to be wide enough for a wheelchair.
ex.zh: 走廊要夠寬，輪椅才過得去。

ex.en: The restroom is at the end of the hallway.
ex.zh: 洗手間在走廊盡頭。

ex.en: Please don't leave boxes in the hallway.
ex.zh: 請不要把箱子放在走廊上。

hallway.en: a long narrow space inside a building with doors on the sides

ex.en: Can I have two hamburgers and a coke, please?
ex.zh: 請給我兩個漢堡和一杯可樂，謝謝。

ex.en: Please give me a hamburger.
ex.zh: 請給我一個漢堡。

ex.en: Most Americans like hamburgers.
ex.zh: 大多數的美國人喜歡漢堡。

hamburger.en: a round piece of cooked meat served in a bread roll

ex.en: Wet floors are a safety hazard.
ex.zh: 濕滑的地板有安全上的危險。

ex.en: Smoking is a serious health hazard.
ex.zh: 抽菸會嚴重危害健康。

hazard.en: something that can be dangerous or cause harm

ex.en: Can you hazard a guess at the price?
ex.zh: 你能猜猜看價格是多少嗎？

ex.en: I'd hazard a guess that he's over fifty.
ex.zh: 我猜他應該超過五十歲了。

hazard.en: to say what you think is the answer even though you are not sure

ex.en: Please read the employee handbook before your first day.
ex.zh: 請在上班第一天前讀完員工手冊。

ex.en: The handbook explains the company's leave policy.
ex.zh: 手冊裡說明了公司的請假規定。

handbook.en: a small book that gives information or instructions

ex.en: He's even more hardworking than you are.
ex.zh: 他比你還要勤奮。

ex.en: She is one of the most hardworking people on our team.
ex.zh: 她是我們團隊裡最勤奮的人之一。

ex.en: Our hardworking staff deserve a bonus.
ex.zh: 我們辛勤的員工值得獲得獎金。

hardworking.en: putting a lot of effort into your work

ex.en: Only a handful of people know the fact.
ex.zh: 只有少數幾個人知道真相。

ex.en: Only a handful of customers complained.
ex.zh: 只有少數幾位顧客抱怨。

handful.en: a small number of people or things

ex.en: He grabbed a handful of rice.
ex.zh: 他抓了一把米。

ex.en: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.
ex.zh: 湯姆彎下腰，抓起一把沙。

handful.en: the amount that you can hold in one hand

ex.en: My two-year-old son is a real handful.
ex.zh: 我兩歲的兒子很難帶。

ex.en: The new intern is a bit of a handful.
ex.zh: 新來的實習生有點難搞。

handful.en: a person who is difficult to control or look after

halt.zh: 停止、中止（常用 come to a halt）

ex.en: As the train came to a halt, all of the passengers wondered what was happening.
ex.zh: 列車停下來時，所有乘客都想知道發生了什麼事。

ex.en: Production came to a halt because of the power outage.
ex.zh: 因為停電，生產全面停擺。

halt.en: a stop in movement or activity

ex.en: The company halted production after the accident.
ex.zh: 事故發生後，公司停止了生產。

ex.en: The government halted the project because of safety concerns.
ex.zh: 政府因安全疑慮叫停了這項計畫。

ex.en: There has been a good apple harvest this year.
ex.zh: 今年蘋果的收成很好。

ex.en: We're expecting a good harvest this year.
ex.zh: 我們期待今年有好收成。

ex.en: There was a large harvest of peaches last year.
ex.zh: 去年桃子大豐收。

harvest.en: the crops that are gathered, or the time when they are gathered

ex.en: Farmers harvest the rice in October.
ex.zh: 農夫在十月收割稻米。

ex.en: The tea leaves are harvested by hand.
ex.zh: 這些茶葉是手工採收的。

harvest.en: to gather crops from the fields

ex.en: The company sold ten million handsets last year.
ex.zh: 這家公司去年賣出一千萬支手機。

ex.en: Pick up the handset and dial 9 for an outside line.
ex.zh: 拿起話筒，撥 9 可以打外線。

handset.en: the part of a telephone that you hold to your ear, or a mobile phone

ex.en: My manager's criticism was harsh but fair.
ex.zh: 經理的批評很嚴厲，但很中肯。

ex.en: Don't be so harsh on yourself.
ex.zh: 別對自己太苛刻。

ex.en: I am slowly adjusting to the harsh climate here.
ex.zh: 我正慢慢適應這裡嚴酷的氣候。

ex.en: These plants can't survive the harsh winter.
ex.zh: 這些植物撐不過嚴寒的冬天。

harsh.en: very cold, hot or difficult to live in

ex.en: We hauled the boxes up the stairs.
ex.zh: 我們把箱子拖上樓。

ex.en: The truck hauls goods across the country.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車在全國各地運送貨物。

haul.en: to pull or carry something heavy with effort, or to move goods by truck

haul.zh: 收穫量；（一批）贓物、戰利品

ex.en: The fishermen brought in a big haul today.
ex.zh: 漁夫們今天滿載而歸。

ex.en: Police found a large haul of stolen goods.
ex.zh: 警方查獲了一大批贓物。

haul.en: a large amount of something that has been caught, won or stolen

haul.zh: for the long haul：長期地、做長期打算

ex.en: We're in this for the long haul.
ex.zh: 我們打算長期投入。

ex.en: The company is planning for the long haul.
ex.zh: 公司正在做長遠的規劃。

haul.en: for a long period of time

ex.en: A rabbit has long ears and a short tail.
ex.zh: 兔子有長耳朵和短尾巴。

ex.en: Do you have a minute?
ex.zh: 你有空一下嗎？

have.en: to own something, or to include it as a part or feature

ex.en: Let's have lunch together.
ex.zh: 我們一起吃午餐吧。

ex.en: We have a meeting at ten.
ex.zh: 我們十點要開會。

have.en: to eat or drink something, or to take part in an event

ex.en: I have already sent the report.
ex.zh: 我已經把報告寄出去了。

ex.en: Have you ever been to Japan?
ex.zh: 你去過日本嗎？

have.en: used with a past form of a verb to show an action is finished or connected to now

ex.en: I have to finish this by Friday.
ex.zh: 我必須在星期五前完成這件事。

ex.en: You don't have to come if you're busy.
ex.zh: 你忙的話不一定要來。

have.en: used to say that something is necessary or must be done

ex.en: You had better get away from here at once.
ex.zh: 你最好馬上離開這裡。

ex.en: You had better check the address again.
ex.zh: 你最好再確認一次地址。

have.en: used to say what someone should do, or something bad may happen

ex.en: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.
ex.zh: 我弟弟手裡拿著一台相機。

ex.en: I entered the room and shook hands with him.
ex.zh: 我走進房間，跟他握手。

hand.en: the part of the body at the end of your arm

ex.en: Tom folded the paper before handing it to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆把紙折起來後才遞給瑪麗。

ex.en: Tom handed the envelope full of cash to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆把裝滿現金的信封交給瑪麗。

hand.en: to give something to someone by passing it to them

ex.en: Can you give me a hand?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我一下嗎？

ex.en: Do you need a hand with that box?
ex.zh: 那個箱子需要幫忙搬嗎？

hand.zh: on the other hand：另一方面

ex.en: On the other hand, the price is higher.
ex.zh: 另一方面，價格比較高。

ex.en: The job pays well. On the other hand, the hours are long.
ex.zh: 這份工作待遇好，但另一方面工時很長。

hand.en: used to introduce a different or opposite point

ex.en: Please hand in your report by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前繳交報告。

ex.en: Did you hand in your homework?
ex.zh: 你交作業了嗎？

hand.en: to give work or a paper to a teacher or boss

ex.en: Who can tell what will happen in the future?
ex.zh: 誰能預料未來會發生什麼事？

ex.en: No matter what happens, you must not give up.
ex.zh: 無論發生什麼事，你都不能放棄。

ex.en: What happened at the meeting?
ex.zh: 會議上發生了什麼事？

happen.en: to take place, often without being planned

ex.en: I happened to be out when the call came.
ex.zh: 電話打來的時候，我剛好不在。

ex.en: Do you happen to know her number?
ex.zh: 你剛好知道她的電話號碼嗎？

happen.en: to do or be something by chance

ex.en: You work too hard these days. Aren't you tired?
ex.zh: 你這陣子工作太拚了，不累嗎？

ex.en: I think it necessary for you to study harder.
ex.zh: 我認為你需要更用功讀書。

ex.en: The difference is this: he works harder than you.
ex.zh: 差別在於：他工作比你努力。

ex.en: Chinese is not the hardest language in the world.
ex.zh: 中文不是世界上最難的語言。

ex.en: It's hard to find a good apartment in Taipei.
ex.zh: 在台北很難找到好的公寓。

hard.en: not easy to do or understand

ex.en: This bread is too hard to eat.
ex.zh: 這個麵包硬到沒辦法吃。

ex.en: The chair was hard and uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 那張椅子又硬又不舒服。

hard.en: firm and not easy to bend or press

ex.en: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
ex.zh: 你的相機只有我的一半大。

ex.en: At last, John and Sue decided to cut the apple into halves.
ex.zh: 約翰和蘇最後決定把蘋果切成兩半。

ex.en: The bird was half the size of a hawk.
ex.zh: 那隻鳥只有老鷹的一半大。

half.en: one of two equal parts of something

ex.en: Half a million children still face malnutrition in Niger.
ex.zh: 在尼日仍有五十萬名兒童面臨營養不良。

ex.en: I waited for half an hour.
ex.zh: 我等了半個小時。

half.en: being one of two equal parts of something

ex.en: The work is only half done.
ex.zh: 工作只完成了一半。

ex.en: I was half asleep when you called.
ex.zh: 你打來時我已經半睡半醒了。

half.en: to the extent of fifty percent or only partly

ex.en: I don't care as long as you are happy.
ex.zh: 只要你開心就好。

ex.en: I am happy to have so many good friends.
ex.zh: 我很高興有這麼多好朋友。

ex.en: I am happiest when I am reading.
ex.zh: 我閱讀的時候最快樂。

ex.en: I'd be happy to help you with that.
ex.zh: 我很樂意幫你處理。

ex.en: We are happy to answer any questions.
ex.zh: 我們很樂意回答任何問題。

ex.en: Are you happy with the new design?
ex.zh: 你對新設計滿意嗎？

ex.en: The client wasn't happy with the delay.
ex.zh: 客戶對延誤不太滿意。

happy.en: pleased with something and not wanting it changed

ex.en: I had my hair cut at a barber's shop.
ex.zh: 我在理髮店剪了頭髮。

ex.en: The girl wore a yellow ribbon in her hair.
ex.zh: 那女孩的頭髮上綁了一根黃絲帶。

ex.en: The hair dresser is cutting the hair with scissors.
ex.zh: 理髮師正在用剪刀剪頭髮。

hair.en: the thin threads that grow on a person's head or on an animal's body

ex.en: A very beautiful picture is hanging on the wall.
ex.zh: 牆上掛著一幅非常漂亮的畫。

ex.en: We hung a Christmas wreath on the front door.
ex.zh: 我們在前門掛了一個聖誕花圈。

ex.en: You can hang your coat over there.
ex.zh: 你可以把外套掛在那邊。

hang.en: to fix something at the top so that the bottom is free

ex.en: Hang on, I need to go to the bathroom.
ex.zh: 等一下，我得去一下洗手間。

ex.en: Hang on a second, I'll get my manager.
ex.zh: 稍等一下，我去叫我的經理。

hang.en: used to ask someone to wait for a short time

ex.en: Please don't hang up; I'll transfer your call.
ex.zh: 請不要掛斷，我幫您轉接。

ex.en: She hung up before I could explain.
ex.zh: 我還來不及解釋，她就掛電話了。

hang.zh: hang out / hang around：閒晃、一起玩

ex.en: Some people were hanging around at the entrance.
ex.zh: 有些人在入口處閒晃。

ex.en: Do you want to hang out this weekend?
ex.zh: 這週末要一起出去玩嗎？

hang.en: to spend time in a place or with friends without doing much

ex.en: Tom could hardly hear what Mary was saying.
ex.zh: 湯姆幾乎聽不見瑪麗在說什麼。

ex.en: It hardly ever snows here in the winter.
ex.zh: 這裡冬天幾乎不下雪。

ex.en: I could hardly follow what Jane said in her speech.
ex.zh: 我幾乎聽不懂珍演講的內容。

ex.en: Hardly had we come home when it began to rain.
ex.zh: 我們一到家就下起雨來了。

ex.en: I had hardly sat down when the phone rang.
ex.zh: 我才剛坐下，電話就響了。

hardly.en: used to show that one thing happened right before another

ex.en: I can say with certainty that he hates me.
ex.zh: 我可以確定他恨我。

ex.en: Bill hates that his father smokes heavily.
ex.zh: 比爾很討厭他父親菸抽得那麼兇。

ex.en: I hate getting up early on Mondays.
ex.zh: 我討厭星期一早起。

hate.en: to dislike someone or something very strongly

hate.zh: hate to：很不想、不好意思（做某事）

ex.en: I hate to bother you, but could you help me?
ex.zh: 不好意思打擾你，可以幫我一下嗎？

ex.en: I hate to say it, but you're wrong.
ex.zh: 我很不想這麼說，但你錯了。

hate.en: used to say politely that you are sorry to do something

ex.en: Tom hung his jacket in the hall closet.
ex.zh: 湯姆把夾克掛在玄關的衣櫃裡。

ex.en: Somebody is waiting for Tom in the hall.
ex.zh: 有人在大廳等湯姆。

ex.en: The restrooms are down the hall on the left.
ex.zh: 洗手間在走廊盡頭左邊。

hall.en: the space just inside the door of a building, or a long passage in it

hall.zh: 會堂、禮堂（city hall 市政府）

ex.en: The teacher assembled the students in the hall.
ex.zh: 老師把學生集合在禮堂。

ex.en: The number of the chairs in the hall is 80.
ex.zh: 禮堂裡有八十張椅子。

ex.en: I passed the city hall on my way to the station.
ex.zh: 我去車站的路上經過了市政府。

hall.en: a large room or building for meetings and events

ex.en: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.
ex.zh: 進教室時請脫帽。

ex.en: There were no hats in that store that fit me.
ex.zh: 那家店裡沒有適合我的帽子。

ex.en: I picked out a new hat at the store.
ex.zh: 我在店裡挑了一頂新帽子。

hat.en: something you wear on your head

ex.en: I don't think that I have any bad habits.
ex.zh: 我不覺得自己有什麼壞習慣。

ex.en: He fell into the habit of keeping late hours.
ex.zh: 他養成了熬夜的習慣。

ex.en: I wish I could break the habit of smoking.
ex.zh: 真希望我能戒掉抽菸的習慣。

habit.en: something you do often without thinking about it

ex.en: This book will do more harm than good.
ex.zh: 這本書弊大於利。

ex.en: From my point of view, cars do more harm than good.
ex.zh: 在我看來，汽車弊大於利。

ex.en: Drinking more water won't do you any harm.
ex.zh: 多喝水對你沒有壞處。

harm.en: damage or injury to a person or thing

ex.en: There is no need to be frightened. He won't harm you.
ex.zh: 不用怕，他不會傷害你的。

ex.en: Too much sun can harm your skin.
ex.zh: 曬太多太陽會傷害皮膚。

ex.en: The scandal harmed the company's reputation.
ex.zh: 這起醜聞損害了公司的聲譽。

harm.en: to hurt or damage someone or something

ex.en: It goes without saying that money cannot buy happiness.
ex.zh: 不用說，金錢買不到幸福。

ex.en: All these things serve to add to our happiness.
ex.zh: 這些都能增添我們的幸福。

ex.en: To love and to be loved is the greatest happiness.
ex.zh: 愛人與被愛是最大的幸福。

ex.en: There are many ships in the harbor.
ex.zh: 港口裡有很多船。

ex.en: The boat was piloted safely into harbor.
ex.zh: 船被安全地引導入港。

harbor.en: a place by the sea where ships stay safe

harbor.zh: 懷有（想法、感情）；藏有、窩藏

ex.en: She still harbors doubts about the plan.
ex.zh: 她對這個計畫仍心存疑慮。

ex.en: Dirty towels can harbor bacteria.
ex.zh: 髒毛巾可能藏有細菌。

harbor.en: to keep a thought or feeling in your mind, or to hide someone

ex.en: Pollution is destroying the habitat of many birds.
ex.zh: 汙染正在破壞許多鳥類的棲息地。

ex.en: The zoo tries to recreate each animal's natural habitat.
ex.zh: 動物園努力重現每種動物的自然棲息地。

habitat.en: the natural place where an animal or plant lives

ex.en: We went halfway up the mountain.
ex.zh: 我們爬到了半山腰。

ex.en: I am halfway through this detective story.
ex.zh: 這本偵探小說我才看到一半。

ex.en: I'm halfway through my sandwich.
ex.zh: 我的三明治吃了一半。

halfway.en: at the middle point between two places or times

ex.en: We stopped at the halfway point to rest.
ex.zh: 我們在中途點停下來休息。

ex.en: By the halfway point of the year, sales had doubled.
ex.zh: 到了年中，銷售額已經翻倍。

halfway.en: at the middle point between two places or times

ex.en: I'm willing to meet you halfway on the price.
ex.zh: 價格方面我願意跟你各退一步。

ex.en: If both sides meet halfway, we can reach a deal.
ex.zh: 如果雙方各讓一步，我們就能達成協議。

halfway.en: to agree to give up some things so both sides are satisfied

ex.en: The hawk caught a mouse.
ex.zh: 那隻老鷹抓到了一隻老鼠。

ex.en: One of the hawk's wings is broken.
ex.zh: 老鷹的一邊翅膀斷了。

hawk.en: a large bird that hunts small animals

ex.en: Vendors hawked souvenirs outside the temple.
ex.zh: 攤販在寺廟外叫賣紀念品。

ex.en: Street sellers were hawking umbrellas in the rain.
ex.zh: 下雨時街頭小販在兜售雨傘。

hawk.en: to try to sell things by calling out in the street

ex.en: Who did you hang out with last weekend?
ex.zh: 你上週末跟誰一起出去？

ex.en: Do you like hanging out with Tom?
ex.zh: 你喜歡跟湯姆一起出去玩嗎？

ex.en: I've been hanging out with him.
ex.zh: 我最近都跟他混在一起。

hang out.en: to spend free time with someone

ex.en: Hang your clothes out to dry!
ex.zh: 把衣服拿出去晾乾！

ex.en: I hung the laundry out in the sun.
ex.zh: 我把洗好的衣服拿到太陽下晾。

hang out.en: to put wet clothes outside so they can dry

ex.en: We haggled with the seller and got a better price.
ex.zh: 我們跟老闆殺價，拿到更好的價格。

ex.en: In some markets, haggling is expected.
ex.zh: 在有些市場，殺價是常態。

haggle.en: to argue about the price of something before buying it

ex.en: They say this old house is haunted.
ex.zh: 據說老房子鬧鬼。

ex.en: I live in a haunted house.
ex.zh: 我住在一棟鬼屋裡。

ex.en: This old house is haunted.
ex.zh: 這個老房子鬧鬼。

haunted.en: visited by the spirit of a dead person

ex.en: He was haunted by memories of the war.
ex.zh: 戰爭的回憶一直困擾著他。

ex.en: She had a haunted look in her eyes.
ex.zh: 她的眼神裡帶著揮不去的陰影。

haunted.en: troubled by sad or frightening thoughts that will not go away

ex.en: The two young girls smiled happily.
ex.zh: 兩個年輕的女孩高興地微笑了。

ex.en: He had no friends, no money, no home...but he played happily all the same.
ex.zh: 他沒有朋友，沒有錢，沒有房子……他照樣玩得很開心。

ex.en: I really hope they can live happily ever after as husband and wife.
ex.zh: 真的希望他們做夫妻白頭偕老。

happily.en: in a way that shows you are glad

ex.en: Years of war left the two groups full of hatred.
ex.zh: 多年的戰爭使這兩個族群充滿敵意。

ex.en: She looked at him with hatred in her eyes.
ex.zh: 她眼裡帶著恨意看著他。

hatred.en: a very strong feeling of dislike for someone

ex.en: Only the hardy workers stayed on the farm through the winter.
ex.zh: 只有吃苦耐勞的工人留在農場過冬。

ex.en: These hardy plants can survive very cold weather.
ex.zh: 這些耐寒的植物能在非常寒冷的天氣中存活。

hardy.en: strong and able to live through difficult conditions

ex.en: It's become a hassle to keep on dyeing my hair.
ex.zh: 一直染髮太麻煩了。

ex.en: Filling out all these forms is such a hassle.
ex.zh: 填這些表格真是麻煩。

ex.en: Online booking saves you the hassle of waiting in line.
ex.zh: 線上預約可以免去排隊的麻煩。

hassle.en: something annoying that takes effort or causes trouble

ex.en: Attention to detail is the hallmark of a good editor.
ex.zh: 注重細節是好編輯的特徵。

ex.en: Friendly service has become the hallmark of the hotel.
ex.zh: 親切的服務已成為這家飯店的招牌。

hallmark.en: a typical feature that shows quality or character

ex.en: Tom is handicapped.
ex.zh: 湯姆是身心障礙者。

ex.en: The building has a special entrance for handicapped visitors.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓有專供身障訪客使用的入口。

ex.en: Parking spaces near the door are reserved for handicapped drivers.
ex.zh: 門口附近的停車位保留給身障駕駛。

handicapped.en: having a body or mind that does not work in the usual way (old-fashioned)

ex.en: We must learn to live in harmony with nature.
ex.zh: 我們必須學會與自然和諧共處。

ex.en: Harmony in the family leads to success in everything.
ex.zh: 家和萬事興。

ex.en: The two families have lived next door in harmony for many years.
ex.zh: 這兩家人當鄰居多年，一直相處融洽。

harmony.en: a peaceful state in which people or things get along well

ex.en: My father must have been handsome in his youth.
ex.zh: 我爸爸年輕的時候一定很英俊。

ex.en: He's very smart, and he's handsome too.
ex.zh: 他很聰明，而且他很帥。

ex.en: Tom is more handsome than you are.
ex.zh: 湯姆比你更帥。

ex.en: She made a handsome profit from selling her old apartment.
ex.zh: 她賣掉舊公寓賺了一筆可觀的利潤。

ex.en: He received a handsome reward for finding the lost dog.
ex.zh: 他因為找到走失的狗而得到一筆豐厚的獎金。

ex.en: The typhoon caused havoc across the whole island.
ex.zh: 颱風在全島造成嚴重災情。

ex.en: The kids wreaked havoc in the living room while we were out.
ex.zh: 我們出門時，孩子們把客廳弄得一團亂。

havoc.en: a situation of great confusion and damage

ex.en: The company has a clear policy against workplace harassment.
ex.zh: 公司有明確的職場騷擾防治政策。

ex.en: Staff should report harassment to human resources.
ex.zh: 員工應向人資部門通報騷擾事件。

harassment.en: behavior that keeps bothering or upsetting someone

ex.en: The haulage company moved the equipment overnight.
ex.zh: 貨運公司連夜運送了這批設備。

ex.en: Haulage costs depend on distance and fuel prices.
ex.zh: 貨運費用取決於距離和燃料價格。

haulage.en: the business of moving goods by road

ex.en: Every worker must wear a harness at this height.
ex.zh: 在這個高度作業，每位工人都必須繫上安全吊帶。

ex.en: The inspector checked her harness before the climb.
ex.zh: 檢查員在她攀爬前檢查了安全吊帶。

harness.en: a set of straps that holds a person so they do not fall

ex.en: It is difficult for me to handle the case.
ex.zh: 這個案子我處理起來有困難。

ex.en: Tom should have handled the situation differently.
ex.zh: 湯姆當時應該用別的方式處理那個狀況。

ex.en: I’m still thinking how I’m going to handle this.
ex.zh: 我還在想要怎麼處理這件事。

handle.en: to deal with a person, problem or situation

ex.en: Here is a pan without handles.
ex.zh: 這是一個沒有把手的平底鍋。

ex.en: The door handle is broken.
ex.zh: 門把壞了。

handle.en: the part of an object that you hold

ex.en: Please take a handout before the lecture begins.
ex.zh: 上課前請拿一份講義。

ex.en: The handout summarizes today's key points.
ex.zh: 這份講義整理了今天的重點。

handout.en: a paper with information given to people in a class or meeting

ex.en: The farmers don't want handouts; they want fair prices.
ex.zh: 農民不要施捨，他們要的是合理的價格。

ex.en: The government announced cash handouts for low-income families.
ex.zh: 政府宣布發放現金給低收入家庭。

handout.en: money or food given free to people in need

ex.en: Hold on a second, I'll be right back. Don't hang up!
ex.zh: 等一下，我馬上回來，不要掛斷！

ex.en: Please do not hang up the phone.
ex.zh: 請先不要掛上電話。

ex.en: I've got to hang up now. Someone is waiting to use the phone.
ex.zh: 我得掛電話了，有人在等著用電話。

ex.en: Hang up your coat, please.
ex.zh: 請把你的外套掛起來。

ex.en: Please hang up your jacket in the closet.
ex.zh: 請把外套掛在衣櫃裡。

hang up.en: to put clothes on a hook or hanger

ex.en: Many fishing boats were tied up in the harbour.
ex.zh: 許多漁船停泊在港口裡。

ex.en: We walked along the harbour and watched the ships.
ex.zh: 我們沿著港邊走，看著船隻。

ex.en: She harboured a secret wish to become a writer.
ex.zh: 她心中暗藏著成為作家的願望。

ex.en: He still harbours doubts about the plan.
ex.zh: 他對這個計畫仍心存疑慮。

ex.en: The company is known for its careful handling of customer complaints.
ex.zh: 這家公司以謹慎處理客訴聞名。

ex.en: Careful handling is needed when you move glass items.
ex.zh: 搬運玻璃製品時需要小心處理。

ex.en: This car has excellent handling on wet roads.
ex.zh: 這輛車在濕滑的路面上操控性極佳。

ex.en: The bike's handling feels smooth and easy.
ex.zh: 這輛腳踏車騎起來操控順暢又輕鬆。

ex.en: Not speaking the language was a big handicap for him.
ex.zh: 不會說當地語言對他來說是個很大的不利條件。

ex.en: Lack of experience is a handicap when looking for a job.
ex.zh: 缺乏經驗在找工作時是一項劣勢。

ex.en: Poor internet handicaps students who study from home.
ex.zh: 網路不穩讓在家上課的學生處於劣勢。

ex.en: The injury handicapped her chances in the race.
ex.zh: 這個傷勢影響了她在比賽中的勝算。

ex.en: He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wall.
ex.zh: 他用鐵鎚把釘子敲進牆裡。

ex.en: Can I borrow your hammer for a few minutes?
ex.zh: 我可以跟你借一下鐵鎚嗎？

ex.en: She hammered the sign onto the wooden post.
ex.zh: 她用鎚子把告示牌釘在木柱上。

ex.en: Someone was hammering on the door in the middle of the night.
ex.zh: 半夜有人在猛敲門。

ex.en: Harry is a short and friendly name for Henry.
ex.zh: 哈利是亨利一個簡短又親切的暱稱。

ex.en: Harry always arrives early to help set up the room.
ex.zh: 哈利總是提早到場幫忙佈置房間。

ex.en: The salesman kept harrying us to sign the contract.
ex.zh: 那位業務員不斷催促我們簽約。

ex.en: Reporters harried the actor with questions all day.
ex.zh: 記者一整天不停地用問題糾纏那位演員。

ha.zh: 哈、哈哈（表示得意、驚訝或笑聲）

ex.en: Ha, I knew you would pick that one!
ex.zh: 哈，我就知道你會選那個！

ex.en: Ha ha, that joke was really funny.
ex.zh: 哈哈，那個笑話真的很好笑。

ex.en: Harriet is an old-fashioned name for girls.
ex.zh: 哈里特是個老派的女孩名字。

ex.en: Harriet Tubman helped many people escape slavery.
ex.zh: 哈里特·塔布曼協助許多人逃離奴隸制度。

ex.en: Hamilton is a surname and also the name of several cities.
ex.zh: 漢密爾頓是個姓氏，也是好幾座城市的名稱。

ex.en: Alexander Hamilton was one of the founders of the United States.
ex.zh: 亞歷山大·漢密爾頓是美國的開國元勳之一。

ex.en: Harvey plays guitar in a small band on weekends.
ex.zh: 哈維週末會在一個小樂團裡彈吉他。

ex.en: Have you met Harvey, the new engineer on our team?
ex.zh: 你見過我們團隊的新工程師哈維了嗎？

ex.en: People say a ghost haunts the old house on the hill.
ex.zh: 人們說山上那棟老房子鬧鬼。

ex.en: The story is about a lady who haunts the castle at night.
ex.zh: 這個故事講的是一位夜裡在城堡裡出沒的女士。

ex.en: The memory of that mistake still haunts him.
ex.zh: 那個錯誤的回憶仍然縈繞在他心頭。

ex.en: Fear of failure can haunt you for years.
ex.zh: 對失敗的恐懼可能會困擾你好多年。

ex.en: This café is a favorite haunt of local students.
ex.zh: 這間咖啡館是當地學生最愛去的地方。

ex.en: The park was his old haunt when he was a boy.
ex.zh: 那座公園是他小時候常去的地方。

ex.en: Harold retired last year and now spends his time gardening.
ex.zh: 哈羅德去年退休，現在把時間都花在園藝上。

ex.en: Harold lent me his ladder for the weekend.
ex.zh: 哈羅德把他的梯子借我用一個週末。

hampshire.zh: 漢普郡（英格蘭南部的一個郡）

ex.en: Hampshire is a county on the south coast of England.
ex.zh: 漢普郡是英格蘭南部海岸的一個郡。

ex.en: We spent a quiet weekend in the Hampshire countryside.
ex.zh: 我們在漢普郡鄉間度過了一個安靜的週末。

harder.zh: 更難的；更堅硬的（hard 的比較級）

ex.en: This exam was much harder than the last one.
ex.zh: 這次考試比上次難多了。

ex.en: Diamond is harder than any other natural material.
ex.zh: 鑽石比任何其他天然材料都硬。

ex.en: The small cafe is a haven for tired students.
ex.zh: 那間小咖啡館是疲憊學生的避風港。

ex.en: The bay was a safe haven for ships during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨中，這個海灣是船隻的安全避風港。

ex.en: Children wear costumes and ask for candy on Halloween.
ex.zh: 小孩在萬聖節會穿上服裝去要糖果。

ex.en: We carved a pumpkin for Halloween last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚為萬聖節雕了一顆南瓜。

ex.en: Halloween falls on October 31 every year.
ex.zh: 萬聖節在每年的十月三十一日。

ex.en: The hail damaged the roof of our car.
ex.zh: 冰雹把我們車子的車頂打壞了。

ex.en: Heavy hail fell for ten minutes and then stopped.
ex.zh: 大冰雹下了十分鐘後就停了。

ex.en: The farmers lost many crops to the hail.
ex.zh: 農夫們有許多作物毀於冰雹。

ex.en: I tried to hail a taxi in the rain.
ex.zh: 我在雨中試著攔一輛計程車。

ex.en: She raised her hand to hail the bus.
ex.zh: 她舉起手招呼公車停下來。

ex.en: The crowd hailed the team as heroes after the win.
ex.zh: 贏球後，群眾歡呼稱讚球隊是英雄。

ex.en: Critics hailed the film as a masterpiece.
ex.zh: 評論家讚揚這部電影是傑作。

ex.en: I had a ham and cheese sandwich for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐吃了火腿起司三明治。

ex.en: They served a whole ham at the holiday dinner.
ex.zh: 他們在節日晚餐上端出了一整隻火腿。

ex.en: Cut the ham into thin slices.
ex.zh: 把火腿切成薄片。

ex.en: The actor hammed it up for the camera.
ex.zh: 那位演員對著鏡頭演得很誇張。

ex.en: He always hams around when people watch him.
ex.zh: 只要有人看他，他就會裝腔作勢。

ex.en: He hastily packed his bag and ran to the station.
ex.zh: 他匆忙地收拾背包，跑向車站。

ex.en: The letter was hastily written and full of mistakes.
ex.zh: 這封信寫得很倉促，錯誤百出。

ex.en: She hastily closed the door when she heard a noise.
ex.zh: 她聽到聲音後匆忙把門關上。

ex.en: What is happening outside? I hear a lot of noise.
ex.zh: 外面發生什麼事了？我聽到很吵。

ex.en: Nothing interesting is happening at school this week.
ex.zh: 這週學校沒什麼有趣的事發生。

ex.en: The street fair was a big happening in our small town.
ex.zh: 街頭市集是我們小鎮上的一件大事。

ex.en: Keep a diary of the day's happenings.
ex.zh: 把每天發生的事記在日記裡。

ex.en: The family faced great hardship after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水過後，這一家人面臨巨大的困境。

ex.en: She overcame many hardships to finish college.
ex.zh: 她克服了許多艱難才讀完大學。

ex.en: The farmer stored hay in the barn for the winter.
ex.zh: 農夫把乾草存放在穀倉裡過冬。

ex.en: The horses ate fresh hay every morning.
ex.zh: 馬匹每天早上都吃新鮮的乾草。

ex.en: I'm tired, so I'm going to hit the hay.
ex.zh: 我累了，所以要去睡覺了。

ex.en: We hit the hay early after the long drive.
ex.zh: 長途開車之後，我們早早就上床睡了。

ex.en: He wiped his face with a clean handkerchief.
ex.zh: 他用乾淨的手帕擦臉。

ex.en: My grandfather always carries a handkerchief in his pocket.
ex.zh: 我爺爺口袋裡總是帶著一條手帕。

ex.en: Hannah reads the same forwards and backwards.
ex.zh: Hannah 這個字正著念反著念都一樣。

ex.en: Hannah is my classmate from Kaohsiung.
ex.zh: 漢娜是我來自高雄的同學。

ex.en: Most spiders in the garden are harmless to humans.
ex.zh: 花園裡的大多數蜘蛛對人類無害。

ex.en: It was a harmless joke, and nobody was upset.
ex.zh: 那只是個無傷大雅的玩笑，沒有人不開心。

ex.en: The glue will harden in about ten minutes.
ex.zh: 膠水大約十分鐘後就會變硬。

ex.en: Cold weather can harden the ground until it is difficult to dig.
ex.zh: 寒冷的天氣會讓地面變硬，很難挖開。

ex.en: Years of hard work hardened her and made her tough.
ex.zh: 多年的辛勞讓她變得堅強。

ex.en: Don't let disappointment harden your heart.
ex.zh: 別讓失望使你的心變得冷酷。

ex.en: Halve the apple and share it with your sister.
ex.zh: 把蘋果切成兩半，和你妹妹分著吃。

ex.en: The new engine will halve the cost of fuel.
ex.zh: 新引擎能讓燃料成本減半。

ex.en: A hare darted across the field and disappeared.
ex.zh: 一隻野兔飛快地跑過田野後消失了。

ex.en: In the fable, the tortoise beat the hare in a race.
ex.zh: 寓言裡，烏龜在賽跑中打敗了野兔。

ex.en: Reporters continued to harass the family outside their home.
ex.zh: 記者持續在他們家門外騷擾這家人。

ex.en: No one should be harassed at work because of who they are.
ex.zh: 任何人都不該因為自己的身分在工作中被騷擾。

ex.en: She put her phone and keys in her handbag.
ex.zh: 她把手機和鑰匙放進手提包。

ex.en: He gave his mother a leather handbag for her birthday.
ex.zh: 他送媽媽一個皮製手提包當生日禮物。

ex.en: The eggs will hatch in about three weeks.
ex.zh: 這些蛋大約三週後會孵化。

ex.en: Two baby birds hatched this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上有兩隻雛鳥孵出來了。

ex.en: The kids hatched a plan to surprise their mother.
ex.zh: 孩子們策劃了一個要給媽媽驚喜的計畫。

ex.en: They hatched the idea over lunch.
ex.zh: 他們在午餐時想出了這個點子。

ex.en: The sailor climbed out through the hatch onto the deck.
ex.zh: 水手從艙口爬上甲板。

ex.en: Close the hatch before the storm gets worse.
ex.zh: 在暴風雨變大前把艙口關上。

ex.en: A hazel tree grows behind our house.
ex.zh: 我們家後面長了一棵榛樹。

ex.en: She picked up a hazel from the forest floor.
ex.zh: 她從森林的地上撿起一顆榛果。

ex.en: He has warm hazel eyes.
ex.zh: 他有一雙溫暖的淡褐色眼睛。

ex.en: The baby's hair was a soft hazel color.
ex.zh: 嬰兒的頭髮是柔和的淡褐色。

harrogate.zh: 哈羅蓋特（英國北部的城鎮）

ex.en: Harrogate is a town in North Yorkshire, England.
ex.zh: 哈羅蓋特是英格蘭北約克郡的一座城鎮。

ex.en: They took the train to Harrogate for a weekend trip.
ex.zh: 他們搭火車去哈羅蓋特度週末。

ex.en: Your handwriting is so neat and easy to read.
ex.zh: 你的字跡好工整，很容易讀。

ex.en: I couldn't read the doctor's messy handwriting.
ex.zh: 我看不懂醫生潦草的字跡。

ex.en: We tried a Hawaiian pizza with pineapple on it.
ex.zh: 我們試了加有鳳梨的夏威夷披薩。

ex.en: She wore a bright Hawaiian shirt to the party.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件鮮豔的夏威夷襯衫去參加派對。

ex.en: The Hawaiians welcomed the visitors with flower garlands.
ex.zh: 夏威夷人用花圈歡迎訪客。

ex.en: He is learning Hawaiian before his trip to the islands.
ex.zh: 他在去島上旅行之前正在學夏威夷語。

ex.en: They live in a quiet hamlet at the foot of the mountain.
ex.zh: 他們住在山腳下一個寧靜的小村莊。

ex.en: The hamlet has only a few houses and a small church.
ex.zh: 這個小村莊只有幾棟房子和一間小教堂。

ex.en: Hamlet is one of Shakespeare's most famous plays.
ex.zh: 《哈姆雷特》是莎士比亞最著名的劇作之一。

ex.en: Our class is reading Hamlet this semester.

ex.zh: 這座公園是青少年常聚集的地方。

handiwork.zh: 手工藝品；親手做的成果

ex.en: She proudly showed us her handiwork, a hand-knitted blanket.
ex.zh: 她驕傲地向我們展示她的手工成品，一條手編毛毯。

ex.en: The children admired their own handiwork on the classroom wall.
ex.zh: 孩子們欣賞著貼在教室牆上自己做的作品。

ex.en: The first robin is a harbinger of spring.
ex.zh: 第一隻知更鳥是春天來臨的預兆。

ex.en: Some people see the new law as a harbinger of bigger changes.
ex.zh: 有些人把這項新法律視為更大變革的先兆。

ex.en: Dark clouds harbinger a coming storm.
ex.zh: 烏雲預示暴風雨即將來臨。

ex.en: The early snow harbingered a long, hard winter.
ex.zh: 這場提早降下的雪預示了漫長而嚴酷的冬天。

handel.zh: （人名）韓德爾，德裔英國作曲家

ex.en: Handel was a composer born in Germany who later lived in England.
ex.zh: 韓德爾是出生於德國、後來定居英國的作曲家。

ex.en: The choir sang a piece by Handel at the concert.
ex.zh: 合唱團在音樂會上演唱了一首韓德爾的作品。

ex.en: The soldiers were buried in hallowed ground.
ex.zh: 這些士兵被安葬在神聖的土地上。

ex.en: The old stadium is a hallowed place for the club's fans.
ex.zh: 這座老球場對球迷來說是神聖的地方。

ex.en: The harmonisation of rules makes trade between the countries easier.
ex.zh: 規則的統一讓兩國之間的貿易更容易。

ex.en: They called for the harmonisation of school hours across the region.
ex.zh: 他們呼籲統一整個地區的上課時間。

ex.en: She got a new hairdo for her sister's wedding.
ex.zh: 她為了姊姊的婚禮換了新髮型。

ex.en: His 1980s hairdo made everyone laugh at the party.
ex.zh: 他那個八〇年代的髮型讓派對上的人都笑了。

ex.en: The two companies played hardball during the talks.
ex.zh: 兩家公司在談判時採取強硬手段。

ex.en: Our boss is willing to play hardball to win the deal.
ex.zh: 我們老闆為了談成這筆交易，不惜採取強硬作風。

ex.en: We had corned beef hash and eggs for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我們早餐吃了碎牛肉馬鈴薯和蛋。

ex.en: The diner serves a great hash with crispy potatoes.
ex.zh: 這家餐館的碎肉馬鈴薯炒得很棒，馬鈴薯香脆。

ex.en: Press the hash key after you enter your code.
ex.zh: 輸入密碼後請按井字鍵。

ex.en: Type a hash before the word to make it a tag.
ex.zh: 在字前面打一個井字號，就會變成標籤。

ex.en: He made a hash of the presentation and forgot half his notes.
ex.zh: 他把簡報搞砸了，還忘了一半的筆記。

ex.en: Don't make a hash of this job, because we only have one chance.
ex.zh: 別把這份工作搞砸，我們只有一次機會。

ex.en: My hamster runs on its wheel all night.
ex.zh: 我的倉鼠整晚都在滾輪上跑。

ex.en: She bought a small cage for her new hamster.
ex.zh: 她為新養的倉鼠買了一個小籠子。

ex.en: He slipped the halter over the horse's head.
ex.zh: 他把籠頭套在馬頭上。

ex.en: The girl led the pony by the halter.
ex.zh: 女孩牽著籠頭帶小馬走。

ex.en: He played a sweet tune on the harmonica.
ex.zh: 他用口琴吹奏了一首甜美的曲子。

ex.en: My grandfather keeps a harmonica in his coat pocket.
ex.zh: 我爺爺的外套口袋裡總放著一支口琴。

ex.en: Hadrian was a Roman emperor.
ex.zh: 哈德良是一位羅馬皇帝。

ex.en: Hadrian's Wall in northern England is named after him.
ex.zh: 英格蘭北部的哈德良長城以他命名。

ex.en: We grilled a halibut fillet with lemon for dinner.
ex.zh: 我們晚餐把大比目魚排佐檸檬烤來吃。

ex.en: The fisherman caught a huge halibut off the coast.
ex.zh: 漁夫在海岸外釣到一條大比目魚。

hah.zh: 哈（表示得意、驚訝或嘲笑）

ex.en: Hah, I knew you would forget your keys!
ex.zh: 哈，我就知道你會忘記帶鑰匙！

ex.en: "Hah! That was easy," she said after finishing the puzzle.
ex.zh: 「哈！真簡單。」她解完謎題後說。

harrowing.zh: 令人痛苦的；驚心動魄的

ex.en: She told us a harrowing story about the flood.
ex.zh: 她對我們講述了一段關於那場洪水的驚心動魄的經歷。

ex.en: The documentary shows the harrowing journey of the refugees.
ex.zh: 這部紀錄片呈現難民們令人心痛的旅程。

haydn.zh: 海頓（奧地利古典樂派作曲家）

ex.en: Haydn was an Austrian composer who wrote over a hundred symphonies.
ex.zh: 海頓是奧地利作曲家，寫過一百多首交響曲。

ex.en: We listened to a string quartet by Haydn at the concert.
ex.zh: 我們在音樂會上聽了海頓的一首弦樂四重奏。

ex.en: The minister's speech was recorded in Hansard.
ex.zh: 部長的演說被記錄在議事錄裡。

ex.en: You can search Hansard to read what was said in Parliament.
ex.zh: 你可以搜尋議事錄來閱讀國會裡說過的話。

ex.en: He is a hardcore fan who has never missed a home game.
ex.zh: 他是個鐵桿球迷，從沒錯過任何一場主場比賽。

ex.en: The band has a loyal hardcore following.
ex.zh: 這個樂團有一群死忠的支持者。

ex.en: She does a hardcore workout five days a week.
ex.zh: 她每週五天做高強度的訓練。

ex.en: It's a hardcore strategy game that takes hours to learn.
ex.zh: 這是一款硬派策略遊戲，要花好幾個小時才能學會。

ex.en: Haiti is a country in the Caribbean.
ex.zh: 海地是加勒比海的一個國家。

ex.en: Port-au-Prince is the capital of Haiti.
ex.zh: 太子港是海地的首都。

ex.en: I love hazelnut spread on warm toast.
ex.zh: 我很愛把榛果醬塗在溫熱的吐司上。

ex.en: She added chopped hazelnuts to the cake batter.
ex.zh: 她在蛋糕麵糊裡加了切碎的榛果。

ex.en: The Han dynasty ruled China for about four hundred years.
ex.zh: 漢朝統治中國大約四百年。

ex.en: The Han are the largest ethnic group in China.
ex.zh: 漢族是中國人數最多的民族。

ex.en: I prefer a hardcover because it lasts longer than a paperback.
ex.zh: 我比較喜歡精裝書，因為比平裝書耐用。

ex.en: The hardcover edition costs twice as much.
ex.zh: 精裝版的價格是兩倍。

ex.en: He bought the hardcover edition as a gift.
ex.zh: 他買了精裝版當禮物。

ex.en: The library has a hardcover copy of the dictionary.
ex.zh: 圖書館有一本精裝的字典。

ex.en: Hanoi is the capital of Vietnam.
ex.zh: 河內是越南的首都。

ex.en: We took a train from Hanoi to the coast.
ex.zh: 我們從河內搭火車去海邊。

ex.en: He used a hatchet to split small pieces of firewood.
ex.zh: 他用小斧頭劈開小塊柴火。

ex.en: Pack a hatchet and a knife for the camping trip.
ex.zh: 露營旅行要帶一把小斧頭和一把刀。

ex.en: He spoke in halting English, but we understood him.
ex.zh: 他用結結巴巴的英文說話，不過我們聽得懂。

ex.en: She took a few halting steps toward the stage.
ex.zh: 她遲疑地朝舞台走了幾步。

ex.en: The harpsichord has a bright, plucked sound.
ex.zh: 大鍵琴的聲音明亮，帶有撥弦的特色。

ex.en: She plays the harpsichord in a small baroque band.
ex.zh: 她在一個小型巴洛克樂團裡彈大鍵琴。

ex.en: The harlequins in the play wore colorful diamond-patterned costumes.
ex.zh: 劇中的丑角穿著繽紛的菱形圖案服裝。

ex.en: Two harlequins danced and joked in the street show.
ex.zh: 兩個丑角在街頭表演中又跳舞又說笑話。

ex.en: The dog sat back on its haunches and waited for a treat.
ex.zh: 狗蹲坐在後腿上，等著吃點心。

ex.en: The butcher cut a large haunch of venison.
ex.zh: 肉販切下一大塊鹿腿肉。

harvesting.zh: 收割、採收（harvest 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The farmers are harvesting rice this week.
ex.zh: 農夫們這週正在收割稻米。

ex.en: We spent the morning harvesting apples.
ex.zh: 我們整個早上都在採蘋果。

ex.en: After the repairs, the old cabin was habitable again.
ex.zh: 修繕之後，那間舊木屋又能住人了。

ex.en: Scientists search for habitable planets far from Earth.
ex.zh: 科學家尋找遠離地球、適合居住的行星。

ex.en: The harshness of the winter surprised the travelers.
ex.zh: 冬天的嚴酷讓旅人們大吃一驚。

ex.en: She was hurt by the harshness of his words.
ex.zh: 他言詞的苛刻傷了她的心。

ex.en: The family lived on a large hacienda in Mexico.
ex.zh: 這家人住在墨西哥的一座大莊園裡。

ex.en: Tourists can stay overnight at the old hacienda.
ex.zh: 遊客可以在這座老莊園過夜。

ex.en: Our team won the game handily.
ex.zh: 我們隊輕鬆贏下比賽。

ex.en: She handily solved the puzzle in five minutes.
ex.zh: 她輕鬆地在五分鐘內解開了謎題。

ex.en: Clothes were piled haphazardly on the chair.
ex.zh: 衣服亂七八糟地堆在椅子上。

ex.en: The tents were set up haphazardly around the field.
ex.zh: 帳篷零零散散地搭在草地四周。

ex.en: The haughty manager rarely greeted anyone.
ex.zh: 那位傲慢的經理很少跟人打招呼。

ex.en: She gave him a haughty look and walked away.
ex.zh: 她傲慢地看了他一眼就走開了。

ex.en: Havana is the capital of Cuba.
ex.zh: 哈瓦那是古巴的首都。

ex.en: Havana lies on the northern coast of Cuba.
ex.zh: 哈瓦那位於古巴的北岸。

ex.en: The farmer piled the dry grass into a huge haystack.
ex.zh: 農夫把乾草堆成一座巨大的草堆。

ex.en: Finding one typo in this long report is like finding a needle in a haystack.
ex.zh: 要在這份長報告裡找出一個錯字，就像大海撈針。

ex.en: The harried waiter ran between the crowded tables.
ex.zh: 焦頭爛額的服務生在擁擠的桌子間奔跑。

ex.en: She looked harried after a long day with the kids.
ex.zh: 和孩子們忙了一整天後，她看起來疲憊不堪。

ex.en: He looked haggard after three sleepless nights.
ex.zh: 連續三個晚上沒睡後，他看起來憔悴不堪。

ex.en: The haggard travelers finally reached the village.
ex.zh: 那些憔悴的旅人終於抵達了村莊。

ex.en: The puppy was born hairless and pink.
ex.zh: 小狗出生時身上沒毛，粉粉的。

ex.en: He shaved his head and now looks completely hairless.
ex.zh: 他把頭剃光了，現在看起來完全沒頭髮。

ex.en: Ignore the haters and keep doing what you love.
ex.zh: 別理那些酸民，繼續做你喜歡的事。

ex.en: He has a few haters online who leave mean comments.
ex.zh: 他在網路上有幾個酸民，常留下刻薄的留言。

ex.en: A tall, dark-haired man waited by the door.
ex.zh: 一位高個子、黑髮的男子在門邊等著。

ex.en: She is the red-haired girl sitting in the front row.
ex.zh: 她就是坐在前排的那位紅髮女孩。

ex.en: The farmer drove a big harvester across the wheat field.
ex.zh: 農夫開著一台大型收割機穿過麥田。

ex.en: Each harvester can cut several rows at once.
ex.zh: 每台收割機一次能割好幾排。

ex.en: The constant hammering next door woke me up.
ex.zh: 隔壁不停的敲打聲把我吵醒了。

ex.en: The hammering of nails went on all afternoon.
ex.zh: 釘釘子的敲擊聲持續了整個下午。

ex.en: Our team took a hammering in the final match.
ex.zh: 我們隊伍在決賽中慘敗。

ex.en: The mayor took a public hammering over the budget.
ex.zh: 市長因預算問題遭到公開猛烈抨擊。

ex.en: People with a high fever may hallucinate and see things that are not there.
ex.zh: 發高燒的人可能會產生幻覺，看到不存在的東西。

ex.en: After two days without sleep, he began to hallucinate.
ex.zh: 兩天沒睡之後，他開始出現幻覺。

ex.en: The handover of the keys will take place on Friday.
ex.zh: 鑰匙的移交將在星期五進行。

ex.en: A clear handover between shifts prevents mistakes.
ex.zh: 班與班之間清楚的交接可以避免錯誤。

ex.en: She held her bun in place with a metal hairpin.
ex.zh: 她用一支金屬髮夾固定住髮髻。

ex.en: I found a hairpin on the floor of the dance studio.
ex.zh: 我在舞蹈教室的地板上撿到一支髮夾。

ex.en: We ordered fried haddock with chips.
ex.zh: 我們點了炸黑線鱈配薯條。

ex.en: Haddock is a popular white fish in many countries.
ex.zh: 黑線鱈在許多國家是很受歡迎的白肉魚。

ex.en: Chlorine is a halogen found in many cleaning products.
ex.zh: 氯是一種鹵素，存在於許多清潔產品中。

ex.en: Each halogen reacts easily with metals.
ex.zh: 每一種鹵素都很容易與金屬起反應。

ex.en: We hired a handyman to fix the leaking sink.
ex.zh: 我們請了一位修繕工來修漏水的水槽。

ex.en: My neighbor is a real handyman who can repair almost anything.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是個萬能師傅，幾乎什麼都能修。

ex.en: The harassed mother tried to calm three crying children.
ex.zh: 焦頭爛額的媽媽試著安撫三個哭鬧的孩子。

ex.en: He looked harassed after a long day of meetings.
ex.zh: 開了一整天的會後，他看起來疲憊不堪。

handcrafted.zh: 手工製作（handcraft 的過去式／過去分詞）

ex.en: The table was handcrafted by a local carpenter.
ex.zh: 這張桌子是當地木匠手工製作的。

ex.en: She handcrafted a gift for each of her friends.
ex.zh: 她為每位朋友手工做了一份禮物。

hasidic.zh: 哈西德派的（猶太教的一個支派）

ex.en: The Hasidic community in the neighborhood runs several schools.
ex.zh: 這個社區裡的哈西德派群體開辦了幾所學校。

ex.en: He studied Hasidic stories for his history class.
ex.zh: 他為了歷史課研讀哈西德派的故事。

ex.en: Hang in there. The exams will be over soon.
ex.zh: 撐下去，考試很快就結束了。

ex.en: I know it's tough, but hang in there.
ex.zh: 我知道很辛苦，但再撐一下。

ex.en: She told her friend to hang in there during the hard times.
ex.zh: 她在朋友度過艱難時期時，鼓勵他要撐下去。

hang in there.en: used to tell someone to keep trying when things are difficult

ex.en: Please hand in your homework by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前交作業。

ex.en: He forgot to hand in his report on time.
ex.zh: 他忘了準時交報告。

ex.en: Students must hand in their phones before the exam.
ex.zh: 學生在考試前必須交出手機。

hand in.en: to give your work or a form to a teacher or boss

ex.en: You need to hand in your application form at the office.
ex.zh: 你得到辦公室遞交申請表。

ex.en: She handed in her resignation letter this morning.
ex.zh: 她今天早上遞出了辭呈。

ex.en: Hand in the signed form to the front desk.
ex.zh: 請把簽好名的表格交到櫃台。

hand in.en: to give something such as a document or payment to an office or person

ex.en: She had on a bright red coat yesterday.
ex.zh: 她昨天穿著一件鮮紅色的外套。

ex.en: What do you have on under that sweater?
ex.zh: 你那件毛衣底下穿的是什麼？

ex.en: He always has on a hat when he goes out.
ex.zh: 他出門時總是戴著帽子。

ex.en: I have a lot on this week, so I can't join you.
ex.zh: 我這週事情很多，不能加入你們。

ex.en: Do you have anything on tomorrow evening?
ex.zh: 你明天晚上有任何安排嗎？

ex.en: Don't believe him; he is just having you on.
ex.zh: 別相信他，他只是在唬你。

have on.en: to have a plan or to trick someone

ex.en: Have fun at the party tonight!
ex.zh: 今晚的派對玩得開心喔！

ex.en: The children had fun playing in the snow.
ex.zh: 孩子們在雪地裡玩得很開心。

ex.en: I hope you have fun on your trip.
ex.zh: 希望你旅途愉快。

have fun.en: to enjoy yourself and have a good time

ex.en: The teacher handed out the test papers.
ex.zh: 老師把考卷發了下去。

ex.en: Volunteers hand out free water at the marathon.
ex.zh: 志工在馬拉松活動中發放免費的水。

hand out.en: to give things to many people

ex.en: Please hand over your phone before the exam begins.
ex.zh: 考試開始前請把手機交出來。

ex.en: He handed over the keys to the new owner.
ex.zh: 他把鑰匙交給了新屋主。

hand over.en: to give something to another person

ex.en: Some students hang around the library after class.
ex.zh: 有些學生下課後會在圖書館附近閒晃。

ex.en: Don't hang around outside in the cold.
ex.zh: 別在外面的冷風中逗留。

hang around.en: to stay somewhere without doing much

ex.en: He hangs around with the kids from the basketball team.
ex.zh: 他常和籃球隊的孩子們混在一起。

ex.en: I used to hang around with my cousins every summer.
ex.zh: 我以前每年夏天都和表兄弟姊妹們廝混在一起。

hang around.en: to spend time with a person or group

ex.en: Hang on, I need to find my keys.
ex.zh: 等一下，我得找一下鑰匙。

ex.en: Can you hang on a second while I check?
ex.zh: 你可以稍等一下讓我查查看嗎？

hang on.en: to wait for a short time, often when speaking

ex.en: Hang on to the rail when the bus starts moving.
ex.zh: 公車開動時要抓緊扶手。

ex.en: The child hung on to her mother's hand.
ex.zh: 那個孩子緊緊抓著媽媽的手。

ex.en: Hang on, things will get better soon.
ex.zh: 撐下去，情況很快就會好轉。

ex.en: The team hung on until the final minute.
ex.zh: 球隊撐到了最後一分鐘。

hang on.en: to continue to try in a difficult situation

ex.en: Everything hangs on the weather tomorrow.
ex.zh: 一切都取決於明天的天氣。

ex.en: Our trip hangs on whether we can get cheap tickets.
ex.zh: 我們的旅行取決於能不能買到便宜的機票。

ex.en: Let us have a break after this lesson.
ex.zh: 上完這堂課後我們休息一下吧。

ex.en: He had a break and drank some tea.
ex.zh: 他休息了一下，喝了點茶。

ex.en: You look tired; you should have a break.
ex.zh: 你看起來很累，應該休息一下。

have a break.en: stop work for a short time

ex.en: We had a chat over coffee.
ex.zh: 我們喝咖啡聊了一下。

ex.en: Can I have a chat with you later?
ex.zh: 我晚點可以跟你聊聊嗎？

ex.en: The neighbors had a chat at the gate.
ex.zh: 鄰居們在門口聊了一會兒。

ex.en: Can I have a go on your bike?
ex.zh: 我可以騎騎看你的腳踏車嗎？

ex.en: She had a go at making dumplings.
ex.zh: 她試著包了水餃。

ex.en: Why not have a go at this puzzle?
ex.zh: 何不試試這個謎題？

ex.en: The coach had a go at the players after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽後教練痛罵了球員。

ex.en: Why did she have a go at me?
ex.zh: 她為什麼要罵我？

ex.en: He always has a go at his little brother.
ex.zh: 他老是對弟弟發脾氣。

ex.en: Let me have a look at your homework.
ex.zh: 讓我看一下你的作業。

ex.en: We had a look around the new shop.
ex.zh: 我們在新開的店裡逛了一下。

ex.en: Can you have a look at my car?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我看一下我的車嗎？

have a look.en: look at something for a short time

ex.en: I need to have a rest after the hike.
ex.zh: 健行之後我需要休息一下。

ex.en: The old man had a rest on the bench.
ex.zh: 老先生在長椅上休息了一下。

ex.en: Why not have a rest before dinner?
ex.zh: 晚餐前何不休息一下？

have a rest.en: stop and relax for a while

ex.en: I like to have a shower in the morning.
ex.zh: 我喜歡早上洗澡。

ex.en: He had a shower after the game.
ex.zh: 他比賽後沖了個澡。

ex.en: Please have a shower before dinner.
ex.zh: 請在晚餐前先洗澡。

have a shower.en: wash your body under running water

ex.en: Students have access to the school library.
ex.zh: 學生可以使用學校圖書館。

ex.en: Not everyone had access to clean water.
ex.zh: 不是每個人都能取得乾淨的水。

ex.en: Do you have access to a printer at home?
ex.zh: 你家裡有印表機可以用嗎？

have access to.en: be able to use or get something

ex.en: He had difficulty reading the small words.
ex.zh: 他看那些小字有困難。

ex.en: Many learners have difficulty with English spelling.
ex.zh: 許多學習者在英文拼字上有困難。

ex.en: Do you have difficulty hearing me?
ex.zh: 你聽我說話有困難嗎？

ex.en: I have no idea where my keys are.
ex.zh: 我完全不知道我的鑰匙在哪裡。

ex.en: She had no idea he was coming.
ex.zh: 她完全不知道他會來。

ex.en: We have no idea what to cook tonight.
ex.zh: 我們完全不知道今晚要煮什麼。

ex.en: I have trouble sleeping when it is hot.
ex.zh: 天氣熱的時候我很難入睡。

ex.en: She had trouble finding the address.
ex.zh: 她找不到這個地址，費了一番工夫。

ex.en: Do you have trouble with your new phone?
ex.zh: 你的新手機有什麼問題嗎？

ex.en: The kids had a ball at the beach.
ex.zh: 孩子們在海邊玩得非常開心。

ex.en: We had a ball at the party and stayed until midnight.
ex.zh: 我們在派對上玩得很盡興，待到半夜。

ex.en: Have a heart and let him go home early today.
ex.zh: 行行好，今天就讓他早點回家吧。

ex.en: Please have a heart; I only need one more day to finish.
ex.zh: 拜託行行好，我只需要再一天就能完成。

have a heart.en: used to ask someone to be kind and fair

ex.en: The old couple walked hand in hand along the beach.
ex.zh: 那對老夫妻手牽著手沿著海灘散步。

ex.en: The children crossed the street hand in hand with their teacher.
ex.zh: 孩子們跟老師手牽著手過馬路。

hand in hand.zh: 密切相關、同時並進（go hand in hand）

ex.en: Good health and a good diet go hand in hand.
ex.zh: 健康和良好的飲食是密不可分的。

ex.en: In this company, hard work and rewards go hand in hand.
ex.zh: 在這家公司，努力和回報是相輔相成的。
